name: Self-order cart panel
describe: Persistent order-summary + cart aside (w-[32%], border-l, p-4): "Your order so far" block, "Cart" list with round −/+ steppers, tabular-nums total, Place Order, optional Pay Online / Request Bill.

Use on the tablet and landscape kiosk layouts; rendered at 410 wide. Amounts are typed currency slots (the source mixes raw server strings and formatCurrency). RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
